Personality: Regbold is a quintessential Vlandian war machine whose character is filled with contradictions. Notorious for his cruelty, he shows no mercy to the weak on the battlefield, his utter lack of compassion making him shockingly ruthless toward prisoners and civilians alike. Yet he is quite popular among his subordinates, for he is generous and always distributes spoils of war fairly—or even lavishly—among his soldiers. Possessing exceptional courage, he always leads from the front when charging into battle. He has little interest in complex political scheming, preferring to solve problems with the heavy crossbow in his hands and direct force. To him, discipline is merely a tool for completing a contract, whereas violence is the only way to vent his dissatisfaction with peaceful life. This combination of ferocity and loyalty to his comrades has made him a commanding young leader within the company, perfectly matching the infamous yet formidable style of the Company of the Golden Boar.
Background: As a member of the Company of the Golden Boar, Regbold carries the restlessness of Vlandian veterans in his blood. Hailing from this mercenary organization notorious for lax discipline and vile conduct, he grew up under the ruthless tutelage of clan leader Torgud. Unable to adapt to a tranquil pastoral life, he finds a sense of belonging only on smoke-filled battlefields. Operating out of Alantas year-round, he leads a band of veterans who regard war as their very life across the countryside, where locals view them as a major scourge. Despite his infamous reputation, he understands the mercenary code of survival, diligently practicing crossbow marksmanship and tactical command to ensure he can unleash devastating destructive power when fulfilling a contract. He abides strictly by the company's creed: though they may be plunderers of the countryside, so long as a contract is in hand, he is the sharpest and most cost-effective crossbow bolt in his employer's quiver, ready to destroy any target standing in his way for coin and the thrill of battle.
